subject: PO number assignation glitch and linecode rectify
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha@ledgerworks.com>
To: maya_srinivasan <maya@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: PO request for onboarding - LedgerWorks

Hi Maya / Marcus / Monica,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call this morning. Attached are our completed onboarding form and the CSV with the requested PO details. We intended a single PO with a spend cap of $200,000 for initial committed usage. The CSV lists two line items:
- Professional services (SKU: LW-PS-001) — $120,000
- Platform credits (SKU: LW-PC-100) — $80,000

When we submitted the intake the portal generated two provisional PO numbers (2026-LL-4587 and 2026-LL-4588) and split the platform credits across both numbers. That split will complicate our internal accounting — can you consolidate to a single PO number and ensure the line codes map to our SKUs as above? We also need the PO to reference our vendor tax id (attached W-9 is in onboarding-form.pdf).

Attachments: onboarding-form.pdf, po_request.csv

Samantha Ortiz
Head of Procurement, LedgerWorks
procurement@ledgerworks.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Subject: Re: PO request for onboarding - LedgerWorks

Hi Samantha — thanks for sending these over and for the details. I pulled the provisional records from the intake queue: the system created 2026-LL-4587 and 2026-LL-4588 when the form had a duplicate linecode entry.

Two quick asks so we can move to a single canonical PO:
1) Confirm the single spend cap is $200,000 and that the two SKUs should be allocated exactly as your CSV says (PS $120k / PC $80k).
2) Can you confirm the vendor tax id field in onboarding-form.pdf is the final value (we need it to populate the PO header).

Action plan from our side:
- Place both provisional ponums on temporary hold so no invoices can be applied.
- Marcus will validate linecode mappings and propose the merge path (merge 4587 -> 4588 or vice versa).
- Once LedgerWorks signs the PO amendment doc we will issue the single PO number and update the ledger mapping.

Planned timeline: 24–48 hours after you confirm the items above.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
maya@redwood.com

From: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>

On Mon, Jan 12, 2026 at 09:24 Samantha Ortiz <samantha@ledgerworks.com> wrote:
> When we submitted the intake the portal generated two provisional PO numbers (2026-LL-4587 and 2026-LL-4588) and split the platform credits across both numbers.

Thanks — I traced the assignation path in the onboarding service. Root cause: the upload CSV had an extra blank row and the intake parser treated it as a second line group which triggered split-ponum logic.

Proposed remediation (low risk):
- Merge 2026-LL-4587 into 2026-LL-4588 and set canonical PO = 2026-LL-4588.
- Reassign linecode mapping so LW-PS-001 -> PROC-SVC-PS and LW-PC-100 -> PROC-CRED-PC in our ledger (this aligns with your SKUs).
- Apply spend cap $200,000 at the canonical PO level and cancel the provisional stub for 4587.

I attached a short step-by-step for the merge and the fields we will update in the ledger system. The merge requires a FinanceOps approval ticket (link below) — Monica, can you open the ticket so we can get the ledger change approved?

Attachments: merge-instructions.docx
Related ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PROC-2893

Marcus Lin
Senior Procurement Engineer
Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Hi all — thanks for the quick investigation and detailed plan. Confirming the following:
- Single canonical PO: yes, please use 2026-LL-4588 as the final PO number.
- Spend cap: $200,000 total (PS $120,000 / PC $80,000).
- W-9 and tax id on onboarding-form.pdf are correct.

I attached our signed PO amendment (LW_PO_Amendment_v1.pdf) authorizing the merge and the spend cap at the canonical PO. Please proceed and let me know once FinanceOps posts the ledger change.
